ios._comment: Replace REPLACE_WITH_* with real App Store Connect values before submitting to TestFlight/App Store. Get them at https://appstoreconnect.apple.com
Replace REPLACE_WITH_* with real App Store Connect values for staging. Create a separate App Store Connect app for staging if you want a different bundle ID.

_deployment_docs._comment: SETUP CHECKLIST: 1) Create EAS project: `npx eas-cli init`. 2) Update all REPLACE_WITH_* values above. 3) Drop google-service-account.json at project root (https://console.firebase.google.com -> Project Settings -> Service Accounts). 4) Run `eas build --profile production --platform android` and `--platform ios`. 5) Submit with `eas submit --platform ios --latest` and `eas submit --platform android --latest`.
_deployment_docs.eas_project_id_required: Run `npx eas-cli init` to create a project, then paste the projectId at the top of this file (cli.projectId field)
_deployment_docs.google_service_account_required: Create a service account at https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/serviceaccounts, download the JSON key, save as ./google-service-account.json, and grant the Play Store Admin role
_deployment_docs.app_store_connect_required: Create your app at https://appstoreconnect.apple.com, get the App ID (10-char), Apple Team ID, and ascAppId (numeric)
